dependencyDisclosure: Exact copy of the freshly reopened R05 native; the R04 public copy is its unchanged source and R03/R04 files remain published as they were.

R05 retires the FF02 P01 glazed-frame study (295 objects: contour glazing, rails, mullions, outward door, second table and its two chairs) and adds 83 FF02 C03 objects: steel columns, eaves beams, purlins, PUF wall and roof panels, skylight kerb and polycarbonate, three fixed windows, insulated door, louvre, lab furniture and equipment placeholders, a 1.5-ton split AC.

The retained P01 workbench, one table and three chairs are kept; the table and its two chairs are translated by (+0.727, -0.175, 0) m. All other 1,299 first-floor objects and the whole ground-floor scene are fingerprint-identical to R04.
Twelve new FF02 C03 materials are added; no retained material is changed. No historical scenes, embedded scripts or source paths.
